title: C05: explicit OPE matching chain (reference-match dictionary, one-label assembly), author ledger
body:
## Result and scope

Refs #46

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/46#issuecomment-6828067693, session `ADB991-claude-20261112-0c65`
- Unit IDs or other outputs: package C05 of `YM-000026`. Owned chapters changed: `ope-cutoff.tex`, `ope-grid.tex`, `ope-filtration.tex`, `ope-local-projection.tex`, `ope-phase-prices.tex` (all in `manuscript/existence/`). New report directory `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C05/`. The other 9 owned chapters are unchanged.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Claude (Anthropic), autonomous scheduled agent under @ADB991's account.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

All 14 C05 chapters were read in full. Every proved step was re-verified: constants, quantifier order and rate arithmetic (list in `results/C05/findings.md`). **No mathematical error was found in the proved steps.** The changes are interface repairs that make the same-data handoffs explicit, as `ope-closure-refresh.md` asked:

- **`ope-cutoff.tex`.** The comparison producing `eq:ope-cutoff-discrepancy` was described as "remains to be proved". It is the C05-internal construction `sec:reference-match`, under a swap of scale letters: reference chapters use (opening m, matching k), the cutoff uses (centered k, matching m). An explicit dictionary table was added and checked against Lean `YM.OPE.funding` and `YM.OPE.terminalAfford`. The transported allowance 𝓜 is now defined. The clash between ℓ = connecting cover here and ℓ = occupancy in `sec:ope-grouping` is resolved. C16 `ope-scale-purchases` (O1) is identified as the supplier of the cover-rate condition.
- **New `prop:ope-match-assembly`** (in `ope-cutoff.tex`). It derives `input:ope-match` from the cutoff labels, the phase-price transfer and the filtration estimates, on **one** limit label `Q_n`. Only the auxiliary low-degree approximant is re-extracted. The proof is conditional on explicitly listed analytic inputs.
- **`ope-grid.tex`, `ope-local-projection.tex`, `ope-filtration.tex`.** Precise pointers replace "not yet derived" sentences: the assembly proposition, C06 `sec:leaf-transfer` (x = Q_e) and C14 `sec:finite-rank-kernel-transport` (p_c = A_c, p = T). The conditional status is kept.
- **`ope-phase-prices.tex`.** In the final transfer paragraph the spectators are the coarse group, so the rate is (w_1+εI_0)δ, not (w_2+εJ_0)δ. The undefined w_1, w_2 are now defined. No conclusion changes.

**Remains uncertain or open** (details in `findings.md` and `ledger.md`):
- F1: C14 displays `eq:finite-rank-silent` for bounded families. C05 needs it for subpower-bare-norm families. C14's proof covers that case, but C14 should state it.
- F2: no producer located for the signed reference transitions or the terminal reference identification. The same holds for the triangular column estimates, the local trial comparison, the analytic marked-representation estimates and the dictionary slot property. The OPE theorem therefore remains conditional.
- F3: C16 `assembly.tex` restates the OPE bounds without citing `thm:ope-quantitative`.
- F5: C05 consumes, and does not produce, the O(4) action on field levels. The C03 author ledger in draft PR #69 lists that action as I-C05-O4.

## Evidence

- Pinned source revision: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`; base `codex/existence-monograph` @ `01ef22c`.
- Commands actually run and results:
  - start hashes of all 14 chapters equal `coverage-inventory.json`
  - `python3 scripts/check_blueprint.py`: `Blueprint structure OK: 2 units.`
  - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 22 tests OK
  - `git diff --check`: clean
  - `latexmk -pdf … -outdir=<scratch> existence.tex` from a fresh output directory: exit 0, 875 pages, 0 LaTeX warnings, no undefined references or overfull boxes. The tracked PDF was not touched.
  - pages 196–197, 200 and 692–699 were rendered and inspected
  - Lean source text read for `Columns.step_expand`, `step_transverse`, `whole_origin`, `limit_cap`, `OPE.funding`, `terminalAfford`, `terminalCost` and `Work.G09` (see `correspondence.md`)
- Checks not performed and why: no Lean elaboration, build or `#print axioms`, because Mathlib sources are unreachable from this environment. No independent review.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: no statement of any C05 output changed. New label `prop:ope-match-assembly`. Edges for C03, C06, C13, C14, C15 and C16 are listed in `results/C05/ledger.md`.

## Review and handoff

- [x] The scope matches the task and has no duplicate declaration ownership.
- [x] Source citations and hypotheses have been checked, where applicable. Producer statements were read; Lean was checked by source text only.
- [x] Applicable literature results were sought; substantive steps have detailed proofs or verified references. No literature substitution was made; the arguments are source-specific.
- [x] Structural checks pass.
- [x] Draft/reviewed status is accurate; stale reviews were cleared or renewed. The machine review fields stay null; the 9 unchanged chapters keep their earlier local passes at unchanged hashes.
- [x] The issue has a handoff and links to any durable Bots notes. The handoff is `results/C05/handoff.md` plus the issue comment.

Required next review: mathematics and Lean correspondence of the 5 changed C05 chapters at the final hashes in `results/C05/validation.md`, by a different agent or person. The main item to check is `prop:ope-match-assembly` together with the dictionary table.

This draft does not close #46.
